question: In the DX-Scorecard MBR builder, which KPIs count as "automated/wired" (collectable, "Auto" tag, Collect controls) versus "manual" (inline-editable, "Manual" tag) — is it derived from a non-empty aiUpdateInstructions, from the hardcoded WIRED_METRIC_IDS list in src/views/MbrBuilderView.tsx, or another signal — and how is the "11 of 14 automated" count computed?
recommendation: The Auto/Manual partition that drives the "Auto"/"Manual" tags, Collect controls, and the "N of M automated" count is derived from a non-empty aiUpdateInstructions (a trim-strict predicate), NOT from the hardcoded WIRED_METRIC_IDS list. The instructions are resolved from the roster (config.json) as the sole authority per ADR-002; WIRED_METRIC_IDS is a separate, narrower MBR-builder refresh-wiring signal and should not be used for the automated/manual count.
supporting_points: In src/views/UpdateKpisView.tsx, isAutomatable(kpi) returns (kpi.aiUpdateInstructions ?? '').trim().length > 0, and each row renders the 'Auto' vs 'Manual' tag (tag-auto/tag-manual, data-tag) plus Collect controls purely from resolveAutomatable — the trim-strict predicate fed roster-resolved instructions. Its own comment notes this is the same predicate MbrBuilderView agrees on for the aiUpdateInstructions-driven partition.

The count is computed as automatableCount of totalKpis over the flattened draft: allKpis = draft.buckets.flatMap(b => b.kpis); totalKpis = allKpis.length; automatableCount = allKpis.filter(resolveAutomatable).length — so e.g. "11 of 14" means 11 of 14 flattened KPIs have non-empty roster aiUpdateInstructions, and totalKpis - automatableCount are shown as manual.

Instructions are resolved from the injected roster (config.json), not the snapshot: rosterInstructions maps each roster KPI id to its aiUpdateInstructions, an id absent from the roster resolves to '' and reads as Manual (ADR-002 — the snapshot is an immutable capture and must not be the automatability signal). WIRED_METRIC_IDS in MbrBuilderView.tsx is a distinct, hardcoded list (only two ids) gating per-KPI refresh controls in the MBR builder, separate from the aiUpdateInstructions-based automated/manual classification.
